scope: AION 2 Global; structural checks on current public profile fields, not a class meta guide

evidence.origin: NC official Global character profile and item/Daevanion responses, fetched live on 2026-10-08
evidence.per_action_source: The exact snapshot profile_url; a comparison includes both profile URLs
evidence.per_action_data_time: snapshot.fetched_at (fetch time, not guaranteed game-save time)
evidence.limits: No Korean or Taiwanese numeric limits, costs, rates, launch recipes, level routes, or class-meta thresholds are copied into the engine. Role/goal matching is a disclosed heuristic based on returned effect text.

rules.requires: Known nonnegative capacity and explicitly returned valid occupancy list
rules.conclusion: Report measured empty slots and suggest checking a suitable stone and fee in game
rules.does_not_infer: Missing list means unknown, not empty; no stone ID, BIS stat, price or guaranteed gain

rules.requires: Known nonnegative capacity and explicitly returned valid occupancy list
rules.does_not_infer: An absent godStoneStat field is never evidence of a missing stone

rules.requires: Known current level and item-specific cap, current < cap
rules.conclusion: Check the next single increment, using the cap only as a boundary
rules.does_not_infer: No universal cap, safe enchant level, probability, price, investment recommendation or DPS simulation

rules.requires: Open board, explicitly closed nonempty node, exact skill name in the returned effect and an explicitly equipped skill
rules.conclusion: Name a real node that can add a displayed effect to an equipped skill; ask the player to verify path and resources
rules.does_not_infer: No free points, ready path, priority of a particular skill, or assertion that all board nodes should be opened

rules.requires: Explicitly closed real node with a returned effect whose words correspond to the chosen role, excluding opposite PvE/PvP effects
rules.conclusion: Offer a node as a candidate for inspection
rules.does_not_infer: No optimal path, measured battle gain, available points or total cost

rules.requires: Explicit normalized equipped=true and a PvE/PvP effect opposite to the requested goal
rules.conclusion: Suggest comparing all title bonuses with owned alternatives in game
rules.does_not_infer: The live titleList has no explicit equipped field, so default normalizer keeps equipped=null and this rule stays silent. Display title ID=0 never means no stat titles.

rules.requires: Same known Global region and class; user-declared matching goal and role in reference.coach_context
rules.conclusion: Compare matching slots, identical item/skill IDs and exact board/node IDs as optional targets
rules.does_not_infer: A higher GS/CP, a different item rarity, more open nodes, or a higher skill level does not prove the reference build is stronger or optimal
